name: calculate_shipping_cost
description: Calculate shipping cost for a package using Innovate Logistics proprietary pricing rules. Use this function when customers ask about shipping costs, delivery fees, price quotes, or how much it will cost to ship a package. This function applies weight-based pricing, destination zone multipliers, and customer loyalty discounts. Requires the package weight in kilograms, the destination zone (1-4 for local/regional/national/international), and the customer's loyalty tier (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum). Returns the final calculated cost in dollars.

weight_kg.description: Package weight in kilograms. Must be a positive number. Example: 15.5 for a 15.5kg package. Typical range: 0.1 to 500 kg.

zone.description: Shipping destination zone indicating distance: 1 (local delivery within city), 2 (regional delivery within state), 3 (national delivery across country), 4 (international delivery). Must be one of these four values.

customer_tier.description: Customer loyalty tier determining discount level: Bronze (no discount, 0%), Silver (5% discount), Gold (10% discount), Platinum (15% discount). Must be exactly one of these tier names.
